key_findings.finding: Seeing recognizable animal forms in actual clouds is pareidolia, a visual illusion/misperception of a real external stimulus; hallucination refers to perception without an external stimulus. Therefore, on the described perceptual phenomenon alone, “illusion” is the best clinical distinction.
